name: openbb_equity_search
description:
Search listed companies by name or ticker through the OpenBB Platform (obb.equity.search).
Returns: {tool, provider, data_points (rows before the cap), truncated, data: rows with their dates, ignored_arguments when some did not apply} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): query*; limit (rows returned, 1-1000; default 100; a dated series keeps its most recent rows); provider (intrinio, nasdaq, sec; default sec).
Other searches: yahoo_search_symbols, openbb_etf_search, edgar_company_search. Keys: nasdaq, sec need none; intrinio needs a key in ~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json.
Example: {"query": "semiconductor"}

limit.description: Most rows returned (1-1000); a dated series keeps its most recent rows
